name: Recruiting Agent 2 - Outbox (send, follow up, detect replies)

parameters.content:
## 2. Outbox (runs hourly, Mon-Fri 9am-5pm)
- **Approved** rows: sends the outreach email, status -> Contacted
- **Contacted / Followed up**: checks the Gmail thread for a reply. Reply -> Replied (or Opted out if they said unsubscribe). Bounce -> Email bounced. No reply after N days -> one follow-up in the same thread, then No response.
- **Selected / Rejected** (set by the recruiter): sends the matching template once
- Respects `daily_send_limit` (rolling 24h)
